outcome: Total Nucleated Cells (TNC) in cord blood unit
cohort: The study included 7,463 cord blood units collected at the Liege cord blood bank between 2000 and 2016.
finding: Several obstetric parameters, including cord clamping duration, use of oxytocin, gestational age, birth weight, placenta weight, newborn sex, and epidural use, were found to significantly influence the quality (TNC count and/or volume) of cord blood units.
